settings.setting_timeline_text: Choose your diamond and setting. We set it here in New York and deliver it within three business days.
settings.setting_returns_text: Unworn jewelry, and unset diamonds with their certificate, may be returned or exchanged within 14 days of delivery, with a prepaid, insured label. Once your diamond is set, the ring can be exchanged but not returned. Engraved pieces, bespoke commissions, and specially sourced stones (diamonds not listed on our site) are final sale, and we are happy to offer an exchange or store credit.
settings.setting_holiday_text: Order by December 22 for delivery before Christmas.

settings.title: Identical Brilliance
settings.text: Same fire, same hardness, same sparkle as a mined diamond — because it is a diamond.

settings.title: Certified & Transparent
settings.text: Every stone arrives with an independent grading certificate documenting its cut, color, clarity and carat.

settings.title: Exceptional Value
settings.text: Larger, finer stones for your budget — typically 60–85% less than comparable mined diamonds.

settings.title: Authenticated by Specialists
settings.text: Hallmarks, serial numbers and construction verified against each maison's conventions before a piece is ever listed.

settings.title: Provenance & Papers
settings.text: Original boxes and certificates included where they exist; our own authentication documentation ships either way.

settings.title: Condition, Honestly Graded
settings.text: Every piece is condition-graded and photographed as it truly is — wear is described, never hidden.

settings.title: Designed in New York
settings.text: Every piece begins in the city that trained Laura's eye, drawn and refined in-house.

settings.title: Crafted in Italy
settings.text: Master goldsmiths finish each piece by hand — old-world technique, modern precision.

settings.title: Made to Be Inherited
settings.text: Built for decades of wear, with a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

settings.title: Reference on Every Listing
settings.text: Brand, model and reference number are stated on every watch, with case size and year when the record includes them.

settings.title: Box and Papers, Stated Plainly
settings.text: Each listing says whether the original box and papers are included. Missing items are never implied.

settings.title: Exchanges on Watches
settings.text: Watches can be exchanged rather than returned for a refund. Every order ships free and fully insured.
